title: RBI Exempts Fresh 3-5 Year FCNR(B) Deposits from CRR and SLR Maintenance
summary: Temporarily removes reserve requirements on fresh FCNR(B) deposits to boost dollar inflows till Sept 30, 2026.

blocks.content: Temporarily removes reserve requirements on fresh FCNR(B) deposits to boost dollar inflows till Sept 30, 2026.

items: Reserve Exemption: Fresh FCNR(B) deposits (tenor 3 to 5 years) mobilized between June 8 and Sept 30, 2026 exempted from CRR and SLR.
USD-INR Forex Swap: Introduced US Dollar-Rupee Forex Swap facility for PSU ECBs and bank OFCBs (min 3-yr tenor, up to 5 yrs) at 1.5% p.a.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: CRR under Sec 42(1) RBI Act; SLR under Sec 24 Banking Regulation Act.
